title: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vo

translated_title: 估计量化大语言模型中被沉默的词元
translated_abstract: 量化是压缩大语言模型的标准方法，通常通过困惑度和任务准确率来评估其优劣。我们提出了一个不同的问题：量化之后，模型还能说出哪些词？当一个词元在任何隐状态下都无法成为输出层的首选时，它就被“沉默”了，贪心解码器因此永远无法生成它。我们给出了一种简单且可扩展的方法来估计量化输出头沉默了多少词元，该方法结合了三项检查：一种能让词元获胜的方向（证明该词元是安全的）、词元所在行被其他行包围程度的上界，以及能证明词元永远无法获胜的精确匹配。因此每个计数都是一个经认证的区间：精确匹配构成其下界，被标记的词元只会抬高其上界。在我们报告的几乎所有设置中（低至3比特），区间的两端恰好重合，因此计数是精确的。在三个开源模型上的实验表明，量化确实会沉默词元：在大词表……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种简单可扩展的认证式估计方法，能够精确量化低比特量化下大语言模型输出头中被“沉默”（贪心解码永远无法生成）的词元数量，发现量化确实会导致词元被沉默。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple, scalable certified method to estimate how many tokens a quantized LLM output head silences—tokens a greedy decoder can never produce—and shows the counts are exact down to 3-bit quantization, revealing that quantization does silence tokens across three open models.
